name: Catppuccin Mocha

provenance.bg.inset: spec: 'Secondary Panes = Crust, Mantle'; consensus: statusline bg mantle 2/4 ports
provenance.bg.surface: spec: 'Surface Elements = Surface 0/1/2'; port: catppuccin/helix ui.popup = surface0
provenance.bg.raised: consensus: 3/7 ports use surface1 for the list cursor (helix ui.menu.selected, k9s cursorBg, btop selected_bg)
provenance.bg.overlay: port: catppuccin/helix ui.popup and ui.menu bg = surface0
provenance.fg.title: spec: 'Main Headline = Text'
provenance.border.focus: spec: terminal 'Active Border = Lavender'; port: Textual $border, k9s frame.border.focusColor
provenance.accent.primary: choice: ports make the accent user-selectable ({accent} in lazygit/yazi); blue = style-guide links/tags color and the default lazygit/yazi file
provenance.accent.secondary: port: Textual secondary = mauve; style guide editor keyword hue
provenance.selection.bg: spec: 'Selection Background = Overlay 2 at 20-30% opacity' -> derived: overlay2 @25% over base [blend(overlay2, base, 0.25)]
provenance.selection.fg: spec: body text = Text; port: helix ui.menu.selected fg = text
provenance.selection.inactive.bg: choice: one step below the active selection fill (lazygit's only value, overlay0, is brighter than the active fill)
provenance.text-selection.bg: spec: 'Selection Background = Overlay 2 at 20-30% opacity' [derived: blend(overlay2, base, 0.25)]
provenance.keyhint.key: consensus: 3/5 ports (lazygit optionsTextColor, k9s frame.menu.keyColor, btop hi_fg)
provenance.keyhint.desc: consensus: 2/3 ports (k9s frame.menu.fgColor, Textual footer description)
provenance.statusbar.bg: consensus: 2/4 ports (helix ui.statusline, gitui cmdbar_bg); spec secondary panes
provenance.statusbar.fg: port: catppuccin/helix ui.statusline fg = subtext1; spec labels = Subtext 0/1
provenance.ramp.low: port: catppuccin/btop temp_start = green; cross-scheme: severity ramp green->yellow->red

notes: Discrepancy (ANSI 7/15): the style guide and palette.json say white = subtext0, bright white = subtext1; both official ports (kitty, alacritty) ship the swap (7 = subtext1, 15 = subtext0). Kept the port values: they are what users' terminals actually show.
Discrepancy (brights): ports set ANSI 9-14 identical to 1-6; palette.json defines generated brighter variants. Kept the port values, so bold-as-bright cannot change hue.
Terminal selection is opaque rosewater/base in kitty; tokens use the style-guide rule (overlay2 at 25% over base) for UI selection instead.
Reviewed the orchestrator's worked example: kept every mapping; added tier-2 tokens with evidence (fg.title, keyhint.desc, scrollbar.*, ramp.*, cursor.fg) and per-theme ansi16 overrides.

ansi16 overrides (hue-aware nearest slot that clears the contract floor; dim modelled as 55% blend): fg.muted -> '15' (default 'default dim' resolves to 4.38:1; now 7.37:1) | fg.faint -> 'default dim' (default '8' resolves to 2.46:1; now 4.38:1)
